fixture.driver: Alternates each shape width between 8 and 10 on the native app frame clock.

android.configuration: AOT minified Release, compiled in speed mode on the emulator

limitations: iOS display-link callback cadence measures main-thread scheduling. Compositor presentation remains unverified.
Android gfxinfo estimates cadence from recent window frame records. The app emits work on the native frame clock, so process CPU totals are not measurements for a fixed number of updates.
Some host builds overlapped the single-layer Android experiments. The Android changes were discarded.
RSS and PSS describe whole-process memory. Object-level retention remains unverified.
